properties.name: name
properties.description: 操作名称, 操作的唯一标识，不可重复, name默认会作为 button 的 children

properties.name: onClick
properties.description: 操作点击回调，支持返回Promise实现loading效果

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: 是否禁止操作

properties.name: visible
properties.description: 是否可见

properties.name: tooltip
properties.description: tooltip 用于操作按钮不可用或者其他场景下的提示文案

properties.name: render
properties.description: 自定义渲染操作按钮

properties.name: subOperation
properties.description: sub operation, 只作用于 menu operation 下

properties.name: arcoButtonProps
properties.description: arco button props

properties.name: arcoPopoverProps
properties.description: 配置 popover

properties.name: arcoPopconfirmProps
properties.description: 配置 popconfirm

properties.name: className
properties.description: 容器className

properties.name: style
properties.description: 组件的附加样式

properties.name: displayNum
properties.description: displayNum 外露的按钮数量

properties.name: maxMenuOperationNum
properties.description: 展示下拉操作的上限数量，用于控制下拉框的最大高度

properties.name: operations
properties.description: 操作按钮配置

properties.name: asyncOperations
properties.description: 异步下拉菜单配置，支持传入二维数组分组, 异步获取函数

properties.name: reloadOperationEachClick
properties.description: 是否每次点击都重新加载

properties.name: spaceSize
properties.description: 按钮间距， 基于 Arco Space 实现

properties.name: onMenuBtnClick
properties.description: 下拉菜单按钮点击的回调, 异步场景下无效

properties.name: defaultButtonType
properties.description: 操作按钮组的默认类型。text类型的按钮不与其他按钮混用，因此当默认类型为text时，Operation.type 会使用组件内的文本按钮；当默认类型为其他类型时，为 button 对应类型

properties.name: arcoButtonProps
properties.description: 下拉菜单外选项和菜单按钮的 Props, 优先级低于 item 中的 arcoButtonProps

properties.name: menuButtonProps
properties.description: 下拉菜单按钮属性, 优先级高于 arcoButtonProps

properties.name: arcoDropdownProps
properties.description: dropdown props

properties.name: renderDropdownButton
properties.description: 自定义 Dropdown Button, 传递内部 的 click 方法给自定义组件
